title: Umphakathi Wesiphambeko Sokuqala
intro: Ezweni lamadolobha asendulo, abantu bake bachuma. Babevakashelwa yisithunywa esinobizo olucacile, kodwa baphenduka balandela indlela okungekho muntu owake wayihamba. Indaba yabo iwukuvukela, ukonakala, kanye nesijeziso esashiya izwe lakubo njengesibonakaliso kubo bonke abacabangayo. Bangobani laba bantu?
clues: Sasihlala emizini yasethafeni, lapho umprofethi wethu asibizela khona ekulungeni.
Sasingabantu bokuqala ukwenza isenzo esibi esingakaze senziwe muntu emhlabeni wonke ngaphambili.
Sasibamba abahambi futhi senza ububi obala emibuthanweni yethu.
Senqaba isithunywa esasithunywe kithi futhi sasongela ukusixosha ezweni lakithi.
Saphuthuma saya endlini yakhe sifuna ukuthi anikele izivakashi zakhe kithi.
Isijeziso sethu sasiyimvula yamatshe, futhi idolobha lethu laphenduka lawa phansi.
verse: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger. (26:162)
